description: P3 citation audit — referenced-claim ledger. DETECTION ONLY: identify every claim that needs external validation (direct cite, named author, semantic-literature) PLUS uncited-but-checkable premises. No interpretation of meaning, no NLM-query planning. Recorded block-by-block as the draft is read, never in bulk. User trims by tag.
per_sentence_rule: Every sentence is exactly one of: (a) own result/framing -> SKIP; (b) tied to a source -> RECORD; (c) uncited-but-checkable premise -> RECORD. Recording (b)+(c) is what prevents missed claims.
RED_FLAG_MANDATE: Capture EVERY external reference that lacks a citation -- uncited factual/legal premise, uncited prior-work claim, AND uncited data source/vendor/archive. These are red flags to address later; NEVER skip them. (user directive, 2026-06-11)
METHODOLOGY_MANDATE: Record EVERY methodology / design / estimator choice and anything suspicious, even when uncited and textbook-standard. Do NOT pass on anything suspicious. check_route=method-review (a scrutiny queue, separate from citation verification). (user directive, 2026-06-11)
BRIGHT_LINE: RECORD, NEVER JUDGE-OUT. If a span is consistent / standard / a cross-ref / a restatement, still record it with a tag + note -- never silently dispose of it in prose. The user trims later. (avoids the override cycle)

reference_form_legend.named-no-cite: author name(s) given, no cite token -> check_route nlm
reference_form_legend.semantic-lit: attribution to a body of work, no name/cite on the span itself -> check_route nlm
reference_form_legend.metadata: bib-page detail (year / venue / closeness ranking) -> check_route bib, not NLM content
reference_form_legend.uncited-premise: checkable factual/legal/method claim with NO source cited -> check_route missing-citation; NOT NLM-verifiable (no paper to check against)
reference_form_legend.uncited-source: external data source / vendor / archive named with NO citation -> check_route missing-citation; red flag for 'cite your source'
reference_form_legend.methodology: a method / design / estimator choice (usually own design, uncited) recorded for later scrutiny -> check_route method-review; includes any suspicious self-claim

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: Using the Dzielinski--Wagner--Zeckhauser decomposition to isolate the call-varying residual of Q\&A uncertainty
While the deal is pending it is material nonpublic information, so securities law forbids discussing it
the call, however, is a standing obligation that cannot be skipped
much of it --- the question-and-answer session --- is unscripted
A growing literature already studies corporate disclosure around acquisitions, though along dimensions other than this one
bidders manage the tone of their earnings press releases ahead of stock-for-stock deals \citep{thewissen2024}
the volume of corporate-strategy vocabulary on conference calls rises with deal activity \citep{ragozzino2024}
recent work examines the precision of management's guidance around transactions \citep{everhart2025}
markets react to acquisition plans once those plans are disclosed \citep{gokkaya2025}
What this work has not measured, to our knowledge, is uncertainty
claims.note: negative claim: none of the four measured uncertainty

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: The two papers closest to ours both appeared in 2024
claims.note: which two is not stated; 2024-dated candidates = thewissen2024 / ragozzino2024 / gokkaya2025(WP 2024-04)

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: The measure of unscripted uncertainty follows the decomposition of \citet{dwz}: we regress the CEO's question-and-answer uncertainty on the executive's own fixed effect and on the call's circumstances and keep the residual
the measurement needed to capture it has only recently become tractable
linking the Capital IQ transcript archive --- parsed so that the CEO's unscripted answers are kept separate from the scripted presentation
claims.note: Capital IQ named as transcript data source, no citation

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: acquisition records from SDC that date each deal's announcement and completion and record whether it was paid in cash or in stock
claims.note: SDC named as deal data source, no citation

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: the lens that reads deal information out of corporate language is being assembled as we write
claims.note: field-maturity / recency framing; ties to I-7; checkable via the corpus's publication dates, not one paper's content

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: its uncertainty dimension is still missing
claims.note: restatement of the I-6 gap at L40 (record-every-instance rule)

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: Three designs then put the prediction to work: a within-firm comparison of a cash acquirer's pre-announcement quarter with its own ordinary quarters, an event study that follows the residual against the firm's cash across the stages of the deal's life --- before announcement, announced but not yet closed, and completed --- and a pooled test of whether the pre-announcement rise is larger for cash deals than for stock
claims.note: intro statement of the three designs (canonical version = §2.4 MD-1/3/4). Consistency check: intro says 'event study'; §2.4 says 'matched-universe event study'.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: the deal is material nonpublic information: the CEO may not discuss it, yet must keep hosting quarterly calls and answering unscripted questions
claims.note: MNPI + call-obligation premise restated here (recurs from I-0a/I-0b)

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: \citet{thewissen2024} show stock-financed bidders inflate the tone of earnings press releases before announcement
claims.note: verb 'inflate' is stronger than intro I-2 'manage' -- verify which the paper supports

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: \citet{ragozzino2024} count strategy vocabulary on calls around deals
a measure built on the share of uncertainty words reads this imprecision more cleanly than the silence, and reads the bind conservatively
claims.note: measurement-design choice: uncertainty-word-SHARE measure (Loughran--McDonald-style word list). lm2011 is in the bibliography but NOT cited here -- possible missing attribution; verify.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: UncResCEO, is the call-level residual of the Dzielinski--Wagner--Zeckhauser decomposition of CEO question-and-answer uncertainty: the component that remains after removing the CEO's persistent style (their equation 4)
claims.note: specific claim about DWZ eq 4: residual = what remains after removing the CEO's persistent style

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: UncPreCEO, the raw uncertainty-word share of the prepared presentation, serves as the within-call control --- exactly its role in their equation 4
claims.note: specific claim about DWZ eq 4: UncPre (prepared-presentation share) is a regressor/control in eq 4

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: in a two-way fixed-effects panel, we ask whether a cash acquirer's residual Q\&A uncertainty is higher in the quarter immediately preceding its announcement than in its own other quarters, with never-acquirers as the fixed-effects baseline --- a pre-window mean shift, not a pre/post difference-in-differences
claims.note: run-up estimator. SUSPICIOUS: (a) never-acquirer FE baseline choice is questionable; (b) text says 'not a pre/post DiD' yet the table is tab:empire_building_did -- naming/labeling mismatch. Intro L44 previews this design.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: The stock arm repeats the design for stock-financed acquirers, whose deals impose the same disclosure constraint without the visible cash footprint
claims.note: placebo-arm design; review whether the stock arm is a valid placebo / adequately powered.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: The timing test is a disclosure-window event study on a matched universe: quarters are classified by the deal's life --- pre-announcement, the announced-but-pending gap, post-completion --- and the path of residual uncertainty is read against the path of the cash ratio over the same windows
claims.note: matched-universe event study; review matching procedure + window classification. Cf. P2 finding M2-04 (event-window sample steps disclosed only in code). Intro L44 previews.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: Cash-specificity is tested formally: a pooled model interacts the pre-announcement indicator with the financing form and tests the cash--stock difference directly (Wald; Table~\ref{tab:empire_cashspec})
claims.note: pooled interaction + Wald cash-specificity test. Intro L44 previews.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: Fixed effects, clustering, and sample filters are reported with each table.
claims.note: SUSPICIOUS self-disclosure claim. Claim covers FE / clustering / SAMPLE FILTERS. M2-04 (post-withdrawal drop, 2nd-announcement truncation) ARE sample filters -> genuine contradiction of this sentence. M2-03 (winsorization) is a transformation, not a filter/FE/clustering -> a SEPARATE disclosure gap, not a contradiction of this sentence. Do not lump.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: We ask two things of the residual: that it move with real uncertainty, and that it not be an artifact of analyst scrutiny
claims.note: UMBRELLA construct-validity strategy (two asks); decomposes into convergent (KC-7), discriminant (KC-8), and analyst-scrutiny rule-out (KC-9). Recorded per bright-line even though redundant with its parts.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: Firm-level political risk \citep{hassan2020}
claims.note: citation claim = hassan2020 provides a firm-level political risk measure. The 'loads positively on the residual' part is an OWN result (P2), not routed here.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: aggregate policy uncertainty \citep{baker2016,davis2016}
claims.note: citation claim = baker2016 provides an aggregate economic policy uncertainty index (US EPU). Loading = own result.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: aggregate policy uncertainty \citep{baker2016,davis2016}
claims.note: citation claim = davis2016 provides an aggregate policy uncertainty index (GLOBAL EPU). Co-cited with baker2016 under one 'aggregate policy uncertainty' label; verify davis2016 = global EPU. Loading = own result.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: product-market competition \citep{hoberg2010,hoberg2016}
claims.note: citation claim = hoberg2010 provides a product-market competition measure (product market synergies/competition in M&A). 'Loads on presentation not residual' = own result.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: product-market competition \citep{hoberg2010,hoberg2016}
claims.note: citation claim = hoberg2016 provides a product-market competition measure (text-based network industries / TNIC). Co-cited with hoberg2010. Loading = own result.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: the same forces that move established uncertainty measures move this one
claims.note: generic reference to 'established uncertainty measures'; instantiated by hassan2020/baker2016/davis2016 but phrased more broadly. Recorded per bright-line.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: The first is convergent validity.
claims.note: convergent-validity design: external uncertainty constructs should load positively on the residual. Text self-notes a limitation: co-movement alone does not show distinctness (motivates the discriminant test).

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: The decisive evidence is discriminant: product-market competition \citep{hoberg2010,hoberg2016} loads on the presentation and not on the residual
claims.note: discriminant-validity design: a persistent industry condition should surface in the script, not the call-varying residual.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: Section~\ref{sec:additional} tests it in three steps --- analysts do scrutinize cash (Table~\ref{tab:cash_scrutiny_validity}); scrutiny alone does not move the residual (Table~\ref{tab:cash_scrutiny_channel}); and the operative test, interacting scrutiny with the pre-announcement window, leaves the run-up intact (Table~\ref{tab:reason_gating})
claims.note: analyst-scrutiny rule-out, three-step design. Step results are own results; the design itself is recorded for scrutiny.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: We read this as a failure to find paired with a within-model dissociation, not a powered equivalence test
claims.note: honest self-limitation: the rule-out is a failure-to-reject + dissociation, NOT a powered equivalence test. Recorded for method-review (advisor-flagged).

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: The textual core is the Capital IQ earnings-call transcript archive, covering the calls of US public firms from 2002 to 2018
claims.note: Capital IQ data source, uncited (recurs from I-10).

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: Each transcript is parsed at the level of the individual speaking turn: every turn carries the speaker's role --- the CEO, other executives, or the questioning analysts --- and a segment marker separating the prepared presentation from the question-and-answer session
claims.note: own transcript-parsing method (speaker-role tagging + presentation/Q&A segment split). Foundational to every measure; review parse accuracy.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: Uncertainty language is measured with the ``uncertainty'' category of the Loughran--McDonald Master Dictionary \citep{lm2011}; we use the 1993--2024 release
claims.note: construct = LM 'uncertainty' word category. lm2011 IS cited here -> resolves CF-4 ('in bib but uncited at L54'); the measure is attributed at L94, not L54. Detail: 1993-2024 release used for a 2002-2018 sample.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: Firm fundamentals come from quarterly Compustat North America files, matched to each call as the most recent fiscal quarter ending on or before the call date
claims.note: Compustat data source, uncited; also a matching rule (most-recent fiscal quarter <= call date).

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: daily CRSP data and IBES earnings records supply the stock-return, market-return, and earnings-surprise controls
claims.note: CRSP data source, uncited (co-named with IBES in DS-6).

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: IBES earnings records supply the stock-return, market-return, and earnings-surprise controls
claims.note: IBES data source, uncited.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: Acquisition records come from SDC: for every deal we observe the announcement date, the completion or withdrawal date, and the payment composition that classifies it as cash- or stock-financed
claims.note: SDC data source, uncited (recurs from I-11).

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: the two are linked through the acquirer's six-digit CUSIP via the CRSP--Compustat link table
claims.note: record-linkage method (6-digit CUSIP via CRSP-Compustat link table); review match rate / false-link risk.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: Following \citet{dwz}, we regress UncAnsCEO on CEO fixed effects, the call's other speech characteristics (the presentation share UncPreCEO, analyst-question uncertainty, and negative tone), firm controls (stock and market returns, earnings growth, and the earnings surprise), and year effects --- their equation 4
claims.note: CANONICAL DWZ eq-4 spec with the FULL regressor list -- highest-value DWZ check (verify the regressor set matches DWZ eq 4). Same sentence: 'its negative is the clarity measure' => Clarity = -CEO-FE (DWZ construct), also to verify.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: UncPreCEO, the raw uncertainty-word share of the prepared presentation (their equation 1), is retained as the prepared-remarks measure
claims.note: claim that DWZ equation 1 defines UncPre (prepared-presentation uncertainty share).

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: PreAnnounceQtr equals one in the single quarter immediately before the firm's first qualifying deal announcement ($e=-1$) and zero otherwise; never-acquirers serve as the fixed-effects baseline. CashRatio is cash and equivalents over total assets. CashScrutiny is the share of a call's analyst question turns containing at least one cash-level or liquidity term from a locked lexicon reproduced in the tables section; HighCashScrutiny flags any such scrutiny
claims.note: own variable construction. Review: PreAnnounceQtr is single-quarter (e=-1) only; never-acquirer FE baseline recurs (MD-1); CashScrutiny rests on a 'locked lexicon' (own cash/liquidity word list) -> verify lexicon. Remaining controls deferred to Appendix.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: The third layer is design-specific: the run-up test drops a treated firm's post-announcement quarters, the event studies cap the post-announcement window at four quarters, and the scrutiny validity and channel tests require at least three analyst Q\&A turns per call
claims.note: third sample layer (design-specific filters). Layers 1-2 = call panel (exclude financial+utility; exclude CEOs <5 calls) and deal universe (>=50% cash/stock arms; first qualifying deal). SUSPICIOUS: P2 M2-04 flagged post-WITHDRAWAL drop + 2nd-announcement truncation as code-only; they do NOT appear in this span -> ties to MD-5 'reported with each table'.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: We estimate $Y_{i,t} = \beta\,\mathrm{PreAnnounceQtr}_{i,t} + \boldsymbol{\gamma}'\mathbf{X}_{i,t} + \alpha_i + \tau_t + \varepsilon_{i,t}$ by two-way fixed-effects OLS --- firm and calendar year-quarter effects, standard errors clustered by firm ... Because the hypothesis is directional, the treatment coefficient is tested one-tailed ($\beta>0$); controls are two-tailed
claims.note: run-up estimating equation (explicit) + 2WFE OLS, firm + year-quarter FE, cluster by firm. ONE-TAILED treatment test (ties to P2 M2-02 NIT tail convention). Post-announcement quarters dropped (recurs MD-1/DS-12).

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: The cash-ratio equation behaves like a standard cash regression before the treatment enters: more levered, larger, and capital-intensive firms hold less cash, growth opportunities raise it
claims.note: RED FLAG: references the determinants-of-cash literature ('a standard cash regression') with NO citation; stylized signs (leverage-, size-, capex-, growth+) asserted as established. No matching bibkey -> needs a citation.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: A side-by-side reading is not yet a formal test of the difference; Main Analysis 3 supplies that
claims.note: honest self-limitation: the cash-vs-stock side-by-side is not a formal difference test (deferred to Main Analysis 3). Companion to KC-10.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: Main Analysis 2 replaces the single pre-announcement indicator with an event-time decomposition ... each treated quarter falls into one of four bins relative to the firm's first deal: two quarters out ($t-2$), the pre-announcement quarter ($t-1$), the announced-but-unclosed window, and the post-completion window. The specification is otherwise that of Main Analysis 1, and with no ordering imposed across bins every coefficient is two-tailed
claims.note: event-time decomposition: 4 bins (t-2, t-1, announced-unclosed, post-completion) on the MATCHED universe (N=28,102/1,320), two-tailed. Recurs MD-3 (matched event study; cf M2-04 matching/window hygiene). t-2 bin functions as a pre-trend/placebo check ('not the tail of a pre-existing trend').

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: A side-by-side reading of cash against stock is still not a formal test of their difference; Main Analysis 3 supplies it
claims.note: honest self-limitation restated here (recurs RU-3); side-by-side cash-vs-stock is not a formal difference test.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: in two steps. The first reruns the event study of Main Analysis 2 side by side on the stock placebo arm (Table~\ref{tab:empire_drop_placebo}); the second pools the two arms in a single interacted model that formally tests the cash--stock difference, for the effect (pre-announcement uncertainty) and for its proposed cause (the cash build-up) alike (Table~\ref{tab:empire_cashspec}). Both tables are two-tailed throughout
claims.note: cash-specificity design (recurs MD-4 pooled interaction). Two steps: (1) placebo event study on stock arm; (2) pooled interacted model testing the cash-stock difference for BOTH the effect (uncertainty) and the cause (cash build-up), two-tailed.

claims.verbatim_thesis_span: We therefore read the result as supported but fragile --- concentration, not strict specificity --- and our wording stays with ``concentrated.''
claims.note: honest self-limitation: cash-specificity is 'supported but fragile' -- only one formal 5% test (effect); the cause's cash-specificity is marginal/full-panel-only. Wording deliberately 'concentrated' not 'specific'. Companion to KC-10/RU-3/DT-2.
